name: AFM level 1 task 5: Scale-Dependent Topographic Roughness
description: Acquire one tapping-mode topography image over a $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$ area at $512 \times 512$ pixels and a time per line of 0.075 s. Set P/I/D gains to 100/50/10, and amplitude setpoint to 70%. Process the image and measure the average roughness. Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$).
submission_format: {"mean_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"mean_roughness_1": "34.20", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question.
